name: Hole Wall
summary:
Your room is the puzzle.

Hole Wall is a mixed reality physics puzzle game that transforms your real-world space into a playable challenge.

Open connected portals across your walls, floor, and other supported surfaces. Send objects through them, redirect movement, interact with mechanisms, and find creative solutions to increasingly complex puzzles.
